hypothesis: After a known opening-range breakout, a later closed-M5 retest/reclaim may offer narrower structural risk. Unproven.
signal: Close inside range rearms; later exterior M5 close arms; a strictly later M5 must touch the boundary and close outside. Signal consumed on confirmation, including any portfolio refusal.
stop: Bid-low/ask-high of the complete retest M5 plus one tick
missing_signal_data: Do not invent bars; stop forming new signals for that session; do not label it a market no-signal
gap_during_position: Stop continuous branch, total unknown, retain known costs
2021_status: Previously consulted development data; never independent holdout
optimization: Three targets frozen before results: 2R control, 3R principal, 4R comparison; no selection by results or retuning.
deadline_preference: Both phases in less than one month if feasible
opposite_close_without_inside_close: Cancel arm; require a subsequent interior close before a new setup
entry_after_retest_refusal: No retry until a new interior-close -> breakout -> later retest cycle
metrics_definition: Win = closed position with net EUR PnL >0 after fees; flat and unknown positions are not wins; partial fills are not separate trades
